description:
Overview: Havells BT5112C is a cord and cordless beard trimmer for men designed for convenient grooming at home or while travelling. The Li-Ion battery, washable body and adjustable comb settings are meant to support everyday use for stubble, short beards and more defined styles.

Battery & Runtime: A rechargeable lithium-ion battery powers the trimmer for up to around 60 minutes of cordless use after an estimated 90-minute full charge, so you can complete multiple trimming sessions between charges. It can also be used in corded mode when connected to power as specified.

Trimming & Length Settings: The stainless steel blades and adjustable comb offer precise trimming with length settings from approximately 0.5 mm up to 10 mm, suitable for maintaining light stubble, medium beards or slightly longer looks depending on your preference.

Waterproof & Cleaning: With an IPX7-rated waterproof body, the trimmer is designed to handle rinsing under running water for cleaning. This helps maintain hygiene when used and cleaned according to the instructions.

Design & Usage: The compact, ergonomic design and blue finish aim to provide a comfortable grip and travel-friendly form factor for regular face and beard grooming routines.
